svg.title: Milestone evidence and remaining work
svg.desc: M1 in progress · committed source baseline. This is an in-progress M1 source snapshot. It is not milestone acceptance or a release declaration. Earlier baseline and current changes are pinned; future snapshots are a maintenance process.
svg.text: m1-968651a · M1 in progress · committed source baseline

a.title: The earlier comparison revision already contains typed styles/PSS integration. The public foundation does not claim to publish or independently qualify a historical M0 snapshot. Use the pinned revision for source comparison; the current cards describe 968651a.

The current committed source has semantic key bindings, press/repeat/release selection, bounded key sequences and scoped quit commands. These additions use the existing router and scheduler. This statement covers these source features, not all M1 work.

Since the earlier baseline, rejected short setup mutations retain typed failure and stop subsequent configure callbacks. This corrects the older limitation where a void configure could record the diagnostic without stopping setup. Current snapshot follows the corrected contract.
a.text: first rejected short setup mutation → stop

a.title: Lazy CLI launch can show help without constructing the scene factory. Fluent stages still prepare and run the same retained core. Single UI-thread ownership, checked observing handles, dirty-only frames and explicit cleanup remain the core invariants.

This source baseline does not include uncommitted range composition, named references/scoped style changes or later controls/focus work. Their delivery and verification are separate. Update the architecture only from integrated, checked source; do not mark the whole milestone complete from this foundation.

a.title: Baseline integration: PR36 CI run 38799649714 completed 6/6 checks successfully for PR head 28723ed04810c597c2fe31f0d75cd9416c5916ac, merged as 968651a. Snapshot authoring separately passed 8 exporter/source/help tests and 40 offline browser map/language/theme/width combinations, including actual SVG downloads. These are documentation checks, not a new C++ runtime suite. New full Doxygen build and delivered artifact: NOT_VERIFIED at authoring boundary; integration remains required.
